Coin builds the house; perk points build you. Open 🎓 Schooling (in your own career it lives on the Lanista tab).
Spend your perk point: a perk from one of the three trees (each says what it does), or hone a trait recruits grade you on. You earn more each week: wins, kept pledges, training.
Your fighters grow in the 🏋 Training Yard. Open it.
One card per fighter. Each bar is a rating — 🏃 Speed, 💪 Strength, 📜 Tactics, 🎭 Crowd — and shows what this week's work adds. Fatigue sits under them.

A plan is only a plan: unlocked sessions never train. Press 🔒 Lock in.
A locked session opens the Doctore's drill: two ratings in one drill, with his bonus — 2 hours, one a week, outside the cap. Pick one.
Lock in again — the drill counts only once it is locked.

Your Doctore. His level (your yard + the hours he spends with the squad) unlocks more drills. Intensity drives every session: more gain, more fatigue. ↻ Same as last week re-plans the squad; 🔒 Lock all locks every card.
